comment: Operating mode Magento uses when calling the UPS API.
modal: Selects the mode for the UPS integration; per the field this governs SSL verification of your Magento server by UPS when rates and labels are requested. Set per website, so different sites can use different UPS connection settings.

comment: Shows or hides the inline documentation markers next to config fields.
modal: When **Yes**, a documentation marker appears beside each configuration field that has a note; **No** hides all markers. The notes are bundled with the module, so toggling this changes only the admin UI and fetches nothing externally.

comment: Whether PayPal Express login opens in an on-site overlay instead of redirecting.
modal: When **Yes**, the buyer completes PayPal login and approval in an in-context overlay on your storefront rather than being redirected to PayPal's site; **No** uses the full-page redirect. Set per website.

comment: Whether a billing agreement is created when the buyer has no active one.
modal: Controls creation of a PayPal billing agreement during Express Checkout when the buyer has no active agreement. Billing agreements let a customer pay with PayPal later without re-authorising. The choice is a defined set of signup behaviours; set per website.

comment: Which PayPal logo image is shown on catalog pages and the homepage.
modal: Selects the PayPal product logo displayed on catalog pages and the homepage (or none). The image is served by PayPal in the chosen style. Store-view scoped, so each view can show a different logo or none.

comment: Whether the cart's shipping options are passed to PayPal for selection there.
modal: When **Yes**, Magento transfers the available shipping options to PayPal so the buyer can pick one on PayPal. Applies only when line item details are enabled. PayPal accepts at most 10 options, so only the 10 cheapest are sent. Set per website.

comment: Whether the Express Checkout shortcut button appears on the shopping cart.
modal: Controls whether the PayPal/Payflow Express Checkout shortcut button is shown on the shopping cart page; it also affects the mini-cart. Store-view scoped, so placement can differ per view.

comment: Enables PayPal's Fraud Management Filters for Payflow Pro transactions.
modal: When **Yes**, Payflow Pro applies PayPal's Fraud Management Filters to transactions. Configure the filters themselves in your PayPal account under Service Settings / Fraud Protection; the Total Purchase Price Ceiling/Floor filters are not supported by this integration. Set per website.

comment: Offer Bank Transfer in all allowed countries or only specific ones.
modal: Chooses whether Bank Transfer Payment is available in **All Allowed Countries** or only in **Specific Countries**. When set to specific, the chosen countries come from the Payment from Specific Countries field. Set per website.

comment: The countries where Bank Transfer is offered when limited to specific countries.
modal: The list of countries in which Bank Transfer Payment is available. Applies when Payment from Applicable Countries is set to Specific Countries. Set per website.

comment: Smallest order total for which Cash On Delivery is offered.
modal: The minimum order total required for Cash On Delivery to appear as a payment option; orders below it do not show the method. Set per website.

comment: Offer Check / Money Order in all allowed countries or only specific ones.
modal: Chooses whether Check / Money Order is available in **All Allowed Countries** or only in **Specific Countries**. When set to specific, the countries come from the Payment from Specific Countries field. Set per website.

comment: Position of Check / Money Order in the checkout payment list.
modal: Sets the ordering of Check / Money Order among payment methods at checkout; a lower number places it higher in the list. Set per website.

comment: Position of Company Credit (Orangecat B2B) in the checkout payment list.
modal: Sets the ordering of the Company Credit (Orangecat B2B) method among payment methods at checkout; a lower number places it higher in the list. Set per website.

comment: The countries where Zero Subtotal Checkout is offered when limited to specific countries.
modal: The list of countries in which Zero Subtotal Checkout (free orders) is available. Applies when the method is restricted to specific countries. Set per website.

comment: Turns the Purchase Order payment method on or off.
modal: When **Yes**, the Purchase Order payment method is available at checkout; **No** disables it. Set per website, so it can be enabled only for selected sites.

comment: The countries where Purchase Order is offered when limited to specific countries.
modal: The list of countries in which the Purchase Order method is available. Applies when the method is restricted to specific countries. Set per website.

comment: Whether the product list updates via AJAX instead of reloading the page.
modal: When **Yes**, the product list loads and refreshes through AJAX so paging and sorting update in place without a full page reload; **No** uses normal page loads. Store-view scoped.

comment: How far ahead cron schedules jobs for the consumers group, in minutes.
modal: The time, in minutes, that cron pre-schedules jobs for the **consumers** group. A larger value queues jobs further in advance. Global (default scope).

comment: How long successful cron job records are kept for the default group, in minutes.
modal: The retention period, in minutes, for successfully completed cron job records in the **default** group before they are cleaned from the schedule table. Global (default scope).

comment: How long failed cron job records are kept for the index group, in minutes.
modal: The retention period, in minutes, for failed cron job records in the **index** group before they are cleaned from the schedule table. Global (default scope).

comment: How often cron history is cleaned up for the translate_products group, in minutes.
modal: The interval, in minutes, between cleanups of cron job history for the **translate_products** group. Global (default scope).

comment: Whether the translate_products cron group runs in its own process.
modal: When **Yes**, jobs in the **translate_products** cron group run in a separate process, isolating them from other groups; **No** runs them in the shared process. Global (default scope).

comment: Window, in minutes, after which a missed translate_select_attributes job is marked missed.
modal: If a scheduled job in the **translate_select_attributes** group does not start within this many minutes of its planned time, it is marked as missed rather than run late. Global (default scope).

comment: Regexes that force matching requests to bypass Varnish and hit the backend.
modal: A list of regular expressions matched against request cookie values; a match makes Varnish bypass its cache and pass the request straight to the Magento backend. Applies only when Varnish is the selected caching application. Global (default scope).
